name: ChecksteadScan
description: Scan with the pinned OWASP Dependency-Check and the Checkstead snapshot. No NVD API key.
helpMarkDown: Runs the Checkstead scanner image. The task does not take an NVD API key. Paths are relative to the sources directory.
author: Chethan K

inputs.name: scan
inputs.label: Scan path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path to scan, relative to the sources directory.

inputs.name: project
inputs.label: Project
inputs.helpMarkDown: Name written on the report. Defaults to the directory name.

inputs.name: output
inputs.label: Output directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: Directory for the Checkstead report and the Dependency-Check reports.

inputs.name: config
inputs.label: Config file
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional path to checkstead.yml. When omitted, ./checkstead.yml is used if it exists.

inputs.name: image
inputs.label: Scanner image
inputs.helpMarkDown: Checkstead scanner image. A release stamps this to the version tag.
